description: Discovery in one call: a list of steps, run in order — { open: url }, { click: ref|selector }, { fill: ref|selector, value }, { press: key, target? }, { inspect: ref|selector|[…] }, { within: region }, { expect: "exact text shown" }. Each step replies as its own tool would; refs from one step work in the next until a step opens a new page. No conditions or loops. It stops at the first step that fails (an element that is not exactly one, text not shown) and returns what ran, the page's region index with refs, and the step to resume from (resumeFrom). Put static elements first and the step that navigates away last.

resumeFrom.description: Skip to this step number (1-based) — from a previous stopped run.

click.description: Click a ref or a CSS selector matching one element (cor_click).

expect.description: Text that must be shown on the page now, exactly.

fill.description: Fill a ref or a CSS selector (cor_fill) with value.

inspect.description: A ref or selector, or several (cor_inspect targets).

press.description: Press a key (cor_press), on target when given.

target.description: For press: the ref or selector to focus first.

within.description: A region's text, controls and entries (cor_snapshot within).

name: cor_explore
title: Run several steps in one call
